provenance.source: Official VALORANT wiki (wiki.playvalorant.com) Update History sections + official patch notes
provenance.note: Patch-tagged changes extracted from the official wiki; each patch note URL verified to resolve (patchNoteResolves). Some hotfix patches (e.g. 9.01, 9.06, 13.09) have no standalone note page -> wiki Update History is the source.

mapStructuralStability: Ascent's layout has been structurally stable across its history: only minor wall/window/door interaction fixes (e.g. v10.04 B Lane wall non-pennable, v6.0 Market door un-breakable), no site/route rework. So map changes do NOT invalidate older Ascent stats; the meta driver is AGENT balance, not map structure.

One crate on A site is no longer pennable, this is to create a safer position on site for defenders
B orb can now be taken from the lower box (previously, you had to double jump up to the box to get it)
Can no longer break the door at Market by using an ability on the wall to the side of it

Jett ’s Tailwind and Skye ’s Trailblazer will no longer stop at the window. Instead, they will burst through and continue movement onto the other side.

Fixed an issue when Phoenix ’s Blaze would break the glass despite not overlapping it.
Fixed a bug where the smoke of Viper's Pit from Viper could appear with artifacts or form incorrectly
Bugfix: Agent utility being hidden behind foliage in several areas

dataWindowRecommendation.fullHistoryUseFor: structural/directional trends + role templates only (153 maps, patch 2.09-13.05)
dataWindowRecommendation.rationale: Map is structurally stable, but agent balance shifted (Chamber 5.12/6.07 nerfs, Jett Tailwind rework 7.04/9.10, economy/ult-point changes). Episode 9+ (>=9.x) captures the modern roster/economy with a usable 42-map sample; <9.x blends older metas.
